bio: I grow tomatoes and herbs, compost food scraps and tend vegetable beds.
I sow seeds, transplant seedlings and improve garden soil.
I care for plants and harvest vegetables in a community garden.
I prune shrubs and water seedlings in raised beds.
I mend torn clothes and sew fabric bags with a sewing machine.
I knit wool scarves and make sweaters with knitting needles.
I weave textiles and stitch garments from cotton fabric.
I repair clothing seams and teach hand embroidery.
